note: Endpoint registry for the upwise_collect MCP server. The model never builds a URL; it picks an id from this file. Common call parameters live in providers.<id>.templates.<name> and a dataset inherits them with "template": "<name>"; values written on the dataset win, and fixed_params / params / response / paging merge key by key. The response block is a declaration: the server reads only the declared items_path and fails loudly when that path is absent, instead of reporting a silent zero. V-World endpoint and parameter names were taken from the author's own working collector (bbox is interpreted in the srsName CRS, so requests go out as EPSG:4326 and reprojection is left to QGIS or the preprocess step). Catalog files merged at runtime: this file, collect_catalog_vworld.json, collect_catalog_sgis.json (both optional, shipped) and <profile>/upwise_chat/collect_user_registry.json (user records, ids must start with "user.").

vworld.title: V-World (Korean national spatial data open API)

datasets.title: Sigungu administrative boundary (lt_c_adsigg)
datasets.notes: Attributes include sig_cd, sig_kor_nm, full_nm. Match on sig_cd; the 2026 edition renamed several full_nm values.

datasets.title: Zoning - urban area (lt_c_uq111)
datasets.notes: Use a small bbox first. Dense city areas hit the 1000 feature cap and the server subdivides the request.

datasets.title: Road centerline from the road name address set (lt_l_sprd)
datasets.notes: Very dense. Keep the bbox small or the request hits the page and byte limits.

datasets.title: Urban planning facility - open space (lt_c_upisuq153)
datasets.notes: Parks, green space and plazas. Filter on the mls_nam attribute after loading. Some polygons are self-intersecting, so run a geometry fix before overlay analysis.
